# telnyx_global_ip_health_check (Resource)

A health check that Telnyx runs against a Global IP's assignments to route traffic away from unhealthy peers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `global_ip_id` (String) Global IP ID.
- `health_check_params` (String) A Global IP health check params. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `health_check_type` (String) The Global IP health check type.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_global_ip_health_check.example <id>
```
